newsitem.title: USA: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices ease, weak demand.
newsitem.headline: U.S. bulk millfeeds - Prices ease, weak demand.

text.p: U.S. millfeed prices were lower in several locations in reaction to light demand as pasture growth lessened the need for feed, dealers said.
The light demand was offset by tight supplies as many flour mills have reduced weekly production to four to five days. St Louis sources said mills there cut production to 2.5 days.
"That is the only thing that is going to stabilize this (millfeed) market because the grass is coming," said a Kansas City millfeed dealer referring the poor demand for feed.
Flour production often slips after Easter, but several dealers said current production levels are below normal. Poor export demand for flour was largely credited for the cutbacks, they said.
